_bundle_provenance.notes: Onboarding bundle from issue #49 (@stevelea); status-code deviation corroborated by issue #38 (@dusty-turner) power-meter data. deviceType added from the device-list entry.

_feature_evidence.detail: Status 2 means charging and status 3 means charged. A power-meter trace corroborates the interpretation.
A read query returned a clean-path value. A write followed by independent readback is unverified.
The app shows Auto, AI Patrol and Floor. The integration uses the family mode map pending device command evidence.
